intro.text: You there! Have you seen a key? Iron, about so long, with my mark on it. I had it at the well this morning and now it's gone. Every penny the village owes the crown is in that strongbox.

options.text: We'll keep an eye out for it.

thanks.text: Good, good. Bring it to me and you'll not regret it. It can't have gone far. Can it?

searching.text: Any sign of my key? I've looked in every bucket in Millbrook.

return.text: My key! Where on earth... no, never mind where. Here, for your trouble.

after.text: Millbrook is in your debt. Mind you don't make a habit of finding other people's keys, though.
